newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London end weak, ignore HK gains.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London end weak, ignore HK gains.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London drifted lower on Monday as leading stocks ignored strong gains in property shares in Hong Kong's Hang Seng index, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended 33.70 points lower at 13,009.10 after the Hang Seng index in Hong Kong earlier rose 1.2 percent to a record high.
"Basically, the banks have been completely ignoring the rises in the property shares," said one dealer, noting a sharp fall in the HSBC Holdings share price.
"Property shares are going up. This is really a sign property markets are looking very good over there (in Hong Kong)," he said.
Traders said they expected market sentiment to remain bullish in Hong Kong in the coming days but they doubted whether London would match any gains step for step.
